title: research.search
description: Search Semantic Scholar for academic papers matching a keyword query, ranked by influence (influential-citation count, with a recency lift). Returns papers only — NO large-language-model synthesis, no brief. Use research.brief when the user wants a synthesized, cited summary. Scope is the open Semantic Scholar Graph corpus, not a private library.

query.description: Free-text research query — a topic, technique, question, or field (e.g. 'sparse mixture-of-experts scaling', 'CRISPR off-target effects').
